weapons.title: Восемь Лун
weapons.silhouette: eight silver moon-discs in a compass orbit over a darkened arena
weapons.motion_path: hero cast gleam, tight orbit expands to an arena-wide eight-lane compass sweep, then crescent return stack
weapons.impact_language: per-victim moon burst on every struck enemy under a darkened arena

performance.v2_budget_note: FAN-3014 rebuild: 13 drawn nodes (backdrop veil, cast-flash windup, eight moon discs, return trail, impact flash) under a 14-node cap; one shared additive CanvasItemMaterial is the whole material budget

quality.reduced_motion_substitute: the translucent arena backdrop and hero cast gleam hold one static intensity, the eight moon-discs hold their compass ring at a steady expanded radius on a single generated frame, and the return crescent fades in as a static pale arc, replacing the orbit spin, the per-disc glow sweep, the first-impact flash and the camera shake
quality.measurement: the backdrop darken layer reaches modulate alpha 0.45 over a 2400x1400 arena rect and the first-impact flash decays from alpha 0.8 to 0 in 0.35s as a one-shot, so translucent presence spans the viewport while the opaque core (orbit plus crescents) stays under 0.30 of a 1152x648 viewport; the flash never repeats (0 Hz) and the single additive flash frame stays under the 0.25 repeating-coverage cap (tests/ultimates/presentation/assassin_ultimate_contact_capture.gd resolutions)
